description: As part of a habitat redesign project, a crew member painted a wooden window covering with Inuit constellations and drilled holes at the star positions, so that sunlight through the covering projected the constellations into the room.
response: Completed and installed over a single evening; no formal request or budget was required.
lesson: Small, cheap, crew-initiated habitat personalization projects (decor, lighting effects) are worth explicitly encouraging — they add tangible morale value at very low cost and time investment relative to major infrastructure work.
